'''Syril''' was a member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. He debriefed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] regarding their participation in [[Operation Third Law]].<ref name="aargau" />
